sources.title: Simatai Great Wall: Visiting Tips from a Local Guide
sources.content:
Simatai Great Wall: Complete Visitor Information

Overview
Simatai represents the most authentic Great Wall section near Beijing, featuring 600+ years of history with minimal restoration. Located 120 kilometers (75 miles) northeast of Beijing—approximately 2.5 hours by car—it stretches 5.4 kilometers with 39 watchtowers, of which 10 are open to visitors.

Key Facts
Chinese name: 司马台 (si ma tai)
Distance from Beijing: 75 miles
Travel time: 2.5 hours
Recommended duration: 1-2 days
Open hours (daytime): 9:00 AM-5:00 PM
Open hours (night): November-April: 5:30 PM-8:40 PM (weekends), 5:30 PM-8:10 PM (weekdays); May-October: 5:30 PM-9:40 PM (weekends), 5:30 PM-9:10 PM (weekdays)

Visiting Routes
Two primary options exist: hiking trails or cable car access.
For active visitors: Going up by trails takes around 40 minutes to the No.2 Watchtower, continuing to the No. 10 Watchtower requires about 2 hours from tower 2-10. Descent can use the same route or cable car from tower 8.
For families/seniors: Cable car access with visits to towers 4-6 provides easier navigation without steep climbing.

Special Features
The site features a dramatic one-sided wall section (single edge), though guides generally discourage visitors from attempting it due to difficulty and safety concerns.

Night Tours vs. Daytime
Night tours offer illuminated views creating a "majestic dragon" effect but access only towers 5-6 via cable car for safety. The local guide notes: "I prefer to travel during the daytime, as you'll see a more comprehensive Great Wall."

Best Visiting Seasons
Spring (March-May): 8-20C with manageable crowds and blooming flowers
Summer (June-August): 20-35C, peak season with July-August crowding; evening visits recommended
Autumn (September-November): 8-20C, picturesque with fall foliage; highest visitor numbers after spring
Winter (December-February): -10 to 10C; snowy conditions create stunning scenery but slippery surfaces

Accessibility
Simatai is not wheelchair-friendly due to bumpy terrain and cable car/step requirements.

Tickets & Practical Information
Purchase tickets online or onsite; advance booking (24+ hours) recommended. Combo packages with adjacent Gubei Water Town available.

Transportation
Bus option: Two daily departures from Dongzhimen Station (9:00 AM, 1:00 PM) to Gubei Water Town; advance booking required.
Private car: Offers schedule flexibility; approximately 1.5 hours.

Simatai vs. Mutianyu
Mutianyu offers closer proximity to Beijing and easier climbing but extensive restoration. Simatai provides authenticity with almost no refurbishment and convenient access to Gubei Water Town's traditional activities and hot springs.

Recommended Strategy
Overnight stays in Gubei Water Town followed by morning Great Wall visits maximize scenery while minimizing crowds.

sources.title: Simatai Great Wall Of China, Beijing: Travel Tips & FAQ 2026
sources.content:
Simatai Great Wall: Complete Content

Overview
Simatai is the only unrestored Ming Dynasty section of the Great Wall, designated as UNESCO's "Original Great Wall." Located in Gubei Water Town, Miyun District, Beijing, it spans 5.4 kilometers with 35 beacon towers and reaches 986 meters at its highest point (Tower 16).

Key Historical Facts
Built: Ming Dynasty (1368-1644), originally during Northern Qi (550-577)
General Qi Jiguang renovated it around 1373
UNESCO Status: Designated as World Cultural Heritage in 1987
Distinguishing Feature: Never been restored and retains original Ming Dynasty appearance

Why Visit
The wall offers an unfiltered glimpse into China's defensive heritage with weathered stones revealing ancient construction techniques. Unlike heavily restored sections elsewhere, visitors encounter authentic historical remains including collapsed walls and uneven terrain that demonstrate 600+ years of history.

The dramatic mountain setting features wall erected on a ridge as sharp as if carved by knives and axes, with valleys stretching below. Simatai pioneered Great Wall night illumination, offering LED-lit evening experiences unavailable at other sections.

Major Features
Tower 16 (Wangjing Tower): The highest point at 986 meters, offering panoramic views and reportedly visible Beijing lights on clear nights.
Tower 14 (Fairy Maiden Tower): Features graceful architectural proportions with curved rooflines demonstrating Ming aesthetic principles.
Suspension Bridge: Modern connector spanning the valley and Yuanyang Lake between eastern and western sections.
Yuanyang Lake: A reservoir created in the 1960s with year-round warm water from underground hot springs.

Visitor Information
Difficulty Level:
Western Section: Moderate slopes, suitable for most fitness levels
Eastern Section: Challenging terrain requiring good physical conditioning
Average Hiking Duration: 2-4 hours depending on distance
Typical Distance: Most visitors comfortably explore 2-3 kilometers

Access Requirements
Advance Reservations: Mandatory, 1-10 days in advance
Chinese Phone Number: Required for confirmation texts
Real Name Registration: Required for all bookings
Daily Visitor Limits: Enforced to manage crowds

Night Illumination Tours
No advance reservations needed. Tickets sold at the entrance after 5:30 PM for separate night experiences distinct from daytime visits.

Child-Friendly Information
Children ages 8+ typically handle hiking well. Stroller access impossible; baby carriers more practical. Western section offers family-friendly easier walking conditions.

sources.title: Simatai Great Wall Travel Tips & Tours
sources.content:
Simatai Great Wall Travel Tips & Tours

Simatai Great Wall is an incomparable section that retains the Ming Great Wall's most original appearance. The section may not be as famous as Badaling or Mutianyu, but it has been a great magnet for history freaks and hikers.

Located in Miyun Town, about 120 km northeast of central Beijing. Time of visit: 2-4 hours; 1-2 days for staying overnight.

The wall stretches 5.4 kilometers with 34 beacon towers, divided into an eastern part and a western part by Yuanyang Lake (Simatai Reservoir).

Unique Experiences
The Simatai Great Wall also offers a unique night tour experience, with lights illuminating the Great Wall, making it resemble a majestic dragon. It is the special section open for night tours. You can capture the graceful sunset against dreamy rosy clouds.

Gubei Water Town is a shining pearl against the Simatai Great Wall. It is a wonderful, relaxing stop after arduous wall walking. You can see rows of traditional-style houses, take a leisurely stroll through picturesque quaint Hutongs and streets, or boat on criss-crossed flowing canals.

sources.title: Simatai Great Wall: Tips & Top Things to Do
sources.content:
Simatai Great Wall: Tips & Top Things to Do

Simatai is famous for its extraordinary views and steep climbs, making it a great choice for the more adventurous. It is the only section of the Great Wall that preserved its original appearance dating back to the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) and has been designated as the "Original Great Wall" by UNESCO.

Best Time to Visit
The best seasons to visit are spring and autumn. In Spring (March to May), temperatures range from about 8 to 20C, and the crowds are not too large.

Tickets & Advance Booking
You need to reserve tickets online at least one day prior to your visit; only a limited number of people are allowed each day. Advance booking is highly recommended, especially for evening tours.

What to Bring
The terrain is rugged and steep; comfortable, non-slip shoes are essential. Simatai is not suitable for small children, people with mobility issues, or those with a fear of heights.

Ticket Prices
Entrance fee: 40 CNY
Cable car: 90 CNY (one way) or 160 CNY (round trip)
Night tour package with Gubei Water Town: 280 RMB (includes water town entrance + night ticket + round-trip cable car)
Overnight guests at Gubei Water Town get special price of 120 CNY including entrance and round-trip cable car.

sources.title: 司马台长城 - 百度百科
sources.content:
司马台长城

基本信息
司马台长城位于北京市密云区古北口镇，距北京市区约120公里。全长5.7公里，现存35座敌楼，被誉为"全球不容错过的二十五处风景之首"。

历史背景
该长城始建于明洪武初年（1373年），在北齐长城基础上修筑。万历年间经戚继光、谭纶整修，成为明代蓟镇防御体系的重要组成部分。

建筑特色
司马台长城以"险、密、奇、巧、全"五大特点著称：
险：沿刀削斧劈般的山脊修建，东段的"天梯"倾斜度达85度
密：敌楼间距平均仅140米，远小于常规500米标准
奇：山下有"鸳鸯泉"——温泉与冷泉相邻
巧：障墙设计使箭孔能穿透所有防御层
全：拥有多种敌楼样式和建筑形制

主要景观
望京楼：海拔986米，是长城最高点
仙女楼：保留汉白玉拱门与并蒂莲花浮雕
鸳鸯湖：由温泉与冷泉汇集而成的水库

旅游信息
门票：40元/人
开放时间：09:00-17:00（最晚入园15:00）
需提前预约，每日三个批次（10:00、12:00、14:00）
建议游玩时长：4小时

荣誉认可
1987年被联合国教科文组织列入世界遗产名录，是我国唯一保留明代原貌的古建筑遗址。2012年获英国泰晤士报评为全球25处必游景点之首。

sources.title: Ultimate Guide to Visiting Simatai Great Wall at Night
sources.content:
Simatai Great Wall Night Tour Information

Simatai Great Wall is the only section opened with night tour available. The wall is beautifully lit up at night and the section between Towers 5 and 6 is open for tourists in the evening.

Night Tour Hours:
May to October: 17:30-21:40 (weekends), 17:30-21:10 (weekdays)
November to April: 17:30-20:40 (weekends), 17:30-20:10 (weekdays)

Tickets for the night tour are not sold separately; you need to buy a package. If you stay at a hotel in Gubei Water Town, you can get a special price of CNY 120 for the Great Wall, which includes entrance and round-trip cable car fees.

All visitors must arrive at the parking lot of Gubei Water Town first, where free shuttle buses depart for the Great Wall entrance at 10:00am, 12:00pm, and 2:00pm.

Daytime hours: April-October: 8:00-18:00; November-March: 8:00-17:30.

sources.title: Simatai Great Wall: Landmark of Beijing Night Tour
sources.content:
Simatai Great Wall: Landmark of Beijing Night Tour

Simatai Great Wall is the only Great Wall section in China open for night tours. The illuminated wall creates a spectacular visual experience against the dark mountain backdrop.

The wall stretches 5.4 km with 35 watchtowers divided by Yuanyang Lake into eastern and western sections. Only the eastern section (towers 2-10) is open to visitors.

Night tour access is limited to towers 5-6 via cable car. The experience includes views of illuminated wall segments, Gubei Water Town lights below, and mountain silhouettes.

Reservation required at least one day in advance. Limited daily capacity enforced. Cable car ride takes 10-15 minutes each way.
